metadata.test_description: Clean isolated subprocess RSS and CPU latency per chunk
metadata.discrepancy_explanation: The earlier 363.3 MB figure occurred because the benchmark was executed inside the monolithic evaluate_truth_and_embedders.py process which already held 300 parsed resumes, 2275 chunk dicts, and BM25 postings in heap (340.6 MB baseline). In a clean isolated process, MiniLM loaded RSS is 124.0 MB (129.2 MB during batch inference) and BGE-small loaded RSS is 141.6 MB (146.6 MB during inference). Steady-state backend server RSS is 164.2 MB. Both comfortably pass the 350 MB Batch 1 cap and 400 MB system bar.
